name: Seeker Eye
storyline:
The protagonist, an editor at an occult magazine, comes across a ghost story titled “The Ghost Story of the Red Roof House.”

Something about the otherwise ordinary story of exploring an abandoned house strikes him as strange. After meeting a certain girl, he begins investigating to determine the truth behind the tale.

Is the ghost story fiction or fact?

As he attempts to unravel the mystery, he becomes caught up in a series of suspicious deaths that seem to mirror the story—only to find himself confronted by even more terrifying supernatural horrors.
summary: A visual novel based on The Red Roof House occult horror story from MAGES. YouTube channel, made and written by the Science;Adventure series staff.
